title: Scaling with Confidence: Calibrating Confidence of LLMs for Adaptive Test Time Scaling
authors_zh: Xuqing Yang（上海交通大学）；Yi Yuan（东南大学）；Shanzhe Lei、Xuhong Wang（上海人工智能实验室）
paper_type_zh: 置信度校准驱动的自适应测试时扩展研究
best_for_zh: 研究如何用可靠不确定性分配推理采样预算的读者。
one_line: C3RL trains verbalized confidence to track correctness, then CAS uses that signal to stop easy queries early and reserve sampling for uncertain ones.
C3RL 先训练模型把口头置信度校准到真实正确率，再由 CAS 据此为不确定问题追加采样。
why: It connects a training-time calibration objective to an explicit inference-time allocation rule and reports both quality and saved samples.
inclusion_reason: It uses calibrated confidence to allocate or stop inference-time sampling, measuring the accuracy-budget frontier directly.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Reasoning systems often spend a fixed number of samples on every query. This wastes inference on questions whose answer is already stable, while an uncalibrated model may also stop too early on difficult questions because a confident-looking response is wrong. Ordinary correctness rewards can improve answer accuracy without teaching a model whether its own expressed confidence deserves trust.

The paper asks whether confidence can be trained as a usable control signal and then used to allocate test-time computation. Its target is not merely a better uncertainty score: it is an inference policy that gives easy prompts fewer samples, gives uncertain prompts more chances, and retains a measurable quality boundary when compared with a fixed-budget majority vote.

推理系统通常为每个问题消耗固定数量的样本。这样会把推理预算浪费在答案已很稳定的简单问题上；而未校准的模型又可能因一个看似自信却错误的回答，在困难问题上过早停止。仅以正确性为目标的奖励可以提高答案准确率，却不会教会模型判断自己口头表达的置信度是否可靠。

本文研究能否先把置信度训练成可用的控制信号，再让它分配测试时计算。目标不只是得到更好的不确定性分数，而是形成一种推理策略：简单提示少采样，不确定提示多尝试，并且相对固定预算的多数投票保留可度量的质量边界。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The core proposal couples Correctness and Confidence Calibration Reinforcement Learning, or C3RL, with Confidence-based Adaptive Scaling, or CAS. C3RL asks a model to emit an answer and a one-to-ten verbalized confidence value. Its reward keeps ordinary answer correctness, rewards confidence that agrees with correctness, and uses a reference-accuracy tag so that calibration is not improved by simply becoming cautiously wrong.

CAS consumes that calibrated output at inference time. After each sampled response, it updates the set of candidate answers and their confidences, then either stops and returns the most confidence-weighted answer or pays for another sample. Thus the object being scaled is a sequence of answer-confidence records, and the allocation decision is grounded in a signal that was explicitly trained to represent correctness likelihood.

核心方案把“正确性与置信度校准强化学习”C3RL 和“基于置信度的自适应扩展”CAS 连接起来。C3RL 要求模型同时输出答案和一到十的口头置信度。其奖励保留普通答案正确性，奖励与正确性一致的置信度，并加入参考准确率标签，避免模型只靠谨慎地答错来获得更好的校准分数。

CAS 在推理时消费这种经校准的输出。每获得一个样本，它都会更新候选答案及其置信度集合，再决定停止并返回置信度加权最高的答案，或支付成本继续采样。因此被扩展的对象是一串“答案—置信度”记录，而资源分配决策依赖的是一个被明确训练为反映正确概率的信号。

title: Method
方法
html:
The training data combines filtered Numina-NLI, WebInstruct-verified, LogicNLI, and LogiQA questions. For each question, the model produces an answer and confidence. C3RL adds three reward terms: a binary correctness term, a calibration term that favors certain-correct and uncertain-incorrect responses, and a reference term derived from prior sampling behavior of the question. The last term is intended to prevent a calibration objective from sacrificing answer quality.

At inference, CAS samples sequentially up to a maximum N. It keeps answer and confidence sets, obtains the largest and second-largest confidence values, evaluates the paper's stopping probability, and halts once that probability crosses a chosen threshold. The study compares the resulting average sample count with 64-response majority voting and Adaptive Consistency on in-domain, text out-of-domain, and multimodal out-of-domain benchmarks.

训练数据由经过筛选的 Numina-NLI、WebInstruct-verified、LogicNLI 和 LogiQA 问题组成。对每个问题，模型输出答案和置信度。C3RL 加入三项奖励：二元正确性项、偏好“自信且正确”与“不确定且错误”的校准项，以及由该问题先前采样行为得到的参考项。最后一项旨在防止校准目标以牺牲答案质量为代价。

推理时，CAS 最多顺序采样到 N 个响应。它维护答案和置信度集合，取最高与次高置信度，计算论文定义的停止概率，并在该概率超过所选阈值时停止。研究将所得平均样本数与 64 响应多数投票和自适应一致性比较，覆盖域内、文本域外和多模态域外基准。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper reports calibration and accuracy across eight text and multimodal datasets. On the Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct multimodal average, C3RL obtains 0.533 accuracy and 0.109 expected calibration error, compared with RLVR's 0.534 accuracy and 0.405 calibration error. This is useful evidence for the narrower claim that the added objective improves confidence alignment without a large accuracy loss in that evaluated setting.

For allocation, the comparison fixes the accuracy target to 64-sample majority voting. CAS reaches matching or slightly higher accuracy while averaging 10.91 samples in-domain, 5.19 on text OOD, and 7.13 on multimodal OOD; these correspond to reported savings of 5.87, 12.33, and 8.98 times. The evidence supports an efficiency frontier under these thresholds, rather than a claim that confidence is calibrated for every model or deployment distribution.

论文在八个文本与多模态数据集上报告了校准和准确率。在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct 的多模态平均结果中，C3RL 的准确率为 0.533、期望校准误差为 0.109；RLVR 则为 0.534 和 0.405。这支持一个较窄的结论：在该评测设置中，新增目标能显著改善置信度与正确性的对应关系，而不会造成很大的准确率损失。

在资源分配实验中，比较把目标准确率固定为 64 样本多数投票。CAS 在域内平均使用 10.91 个样本、文本域外 5.19 个、多模态域外 7.13 个，达到相当或略高的准确率；论文分别报告 5.87、12.33 和 8.98 倍节省。这证明的是这些阈值下的效率前沿，而不是置信度对所有模型或部署分布都已校准。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Prior adaptive self-consistency methods usually infer whether to stop from answer frequency, entropy, or a hand-designed stability rule. This paper changes the decision signal itself: it first trains a verbalized confidence signal under an objective that jointly prices correctness and calibration, then makes that signal the explicit input to the stopping decision. The reference-accuracy reward is the additional guard against a model learning low-confidence wrong answers.

The paper is not simply another confidence-estimation study, because its empirical endpoint is sample allocation under a fixed quality target. It is also not a general solution to uncertainty estimation: the method depends on eliciting a discrete confidence report and on the correctness checks used during training. Readers should distinguish its measured adaptive-sampling gain from any broader claim about factual reliability or safety.

既有自适应自一致性方法通常根据答案频率、熵或手工设计的稳定规则推断何时停止。本文改变的是决策信号本身：它先用同时衡量正确性与校准的目标训练口头置信度，再把该信号作为停止决策的显式输入。参考准确率奖励则用于防止模型通过低置信度地答错来钻校准目标的空子。

这不只是另一项置信度估计研究，因为它的实验终点是在固定质量目标下分配样本。它也不是通用的不确定性解决方案：方法依赖于诱导离散置信度报告，并依赖训练时使用的正确性检查。读者应把已测得的自适应采样收益，与关于事实可靠性或安全性的更广泛主张区分开来。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The calibration reward still relies on answer correctness and a task-specific reference-accuracy tag, so it is easiest to reproduce where answers can be checked automatically. A one-to-ten verbal confidence report can be prompt-sensitive, and the stopping threshold may not transfer when model, task mixture, serving policy, or error cost changes. The paper says code, data, and models will be released but the checked version provides no public artifact URL; reproduction should therefore wait for the release and remeasure both calibration and real wall-clock cost.
校准奖励仍依赖答案正确性和任务特定的参考准确率标签，因此最容易在答案可自动检查的场景中复现。一到十的口头置信度报告可能对提示很敏感；模型、任务混合、服务策略或错误成本改变时，停止阈值也未必能迁移。论文称代码、数据和模型将发布，但核验版本没有公开工件链接；复现应等待发布，并重新测量校准和真实墙钟成本。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this work when a system can ask a model for a confidence-bearing answer and needs a measurable policy for spending more samples only on uncertain cases. Its practical recipe is to validate calibration separately from accuracy, define a budget-matched fixed-sampling baseline, and report the per-slice sample distribution rather than only an average. It is especially relevant when a service has both text and multimodal reasoning traffic, but any reuse should replace the paper's confidence scale and stopping threshold with calibrated values for the intended model and risk tolerance.
当系统能够要求模型给出带置信度的答案，并且需要一个只为不确定案例追加样本的可测量策略时，可使用本文。其实用配方是：把校准与准确率分开验证，设定预算匹配的固定采样基线，并报告各类问题的样本分布而不只给平均值。它尤其适合同时处理文本和多模态推理流量的服务，但复用时应按目标模型和风险容忍度重新校准置信度刻度与停止阈值。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Keep four distinctions in mind. C3RL is the training-time calibration mechanism, whereas CAS is the inference-time allocation rule. The paper evaluates accuracy, ranking-style confidence discrimination, and calibration error separately, which prevents those notions from being collapsed. Its strongest budget result is relative to a 64-sample majority-vote target, not an absolute latency guarantee. Finally, the release status matters: the paper promises artifacts, but the current primary source does not yet expose them.
应记住四个区分：C3RL 是训练时的校准机制，CAS 才是推理时的资源分配规则；论文分别评估准确率、排序式置信度区分能力和校准误差，避免把三者混为一谈；最强的预算结果是相对 64 样本多数投票目标，而不是绝对延迟保证；最后，发布状态很重要，论文承诺工件但当前主来源尚未公开它们。
